title: nedCAPTCHA 2 @NEDCAPTCHA Action Tag Parameters
description: Configuration object accepted by the @NEDCAPTCHA action tag. Omitted properties use the module defaults. Unparseable parameters and missing or invalid CAPTCHA types fall back to math; disabling protection requires the explicit type none.

type.description: CAPTCHA type. Missing or invalid values are treated as math by the module.

capture.description: Keep the verified CAPTCHA response server-side after a successful challenge and save it in the @NEDCAPTCHA field when the first survey submission is saved, including Save & Return Later.

complexity.description: Math challenge complexity. Simple challenges use addition; complex challenges use two operators selected from addition, subtraction, and multiplication.

minValue.description: Minimum initially generated operand value for math challenges. Must not exceed maxValue; the editor rejects inverted ranges, and runtime validation normalizes them to 1 through 10.

maxValue.description: Maximum initially generated operand value for math challenges. Must be at least minValue. Subtraction problems may enlarge an operand to avoid a negative result.

showAsText.description: Render math challenges as plain text instead of an image.

length.description: Number of characters in distorted text image challenges.

reuse.description: Reuse the same generated distorted-image challenge after an unsuccessful attempt.

angleVariation.description: Amount of random rotation applied to individual distorted-image characters.

sizeVariation.description: Amount of random scaling applied to individual distorted-image characters.

noiseDensity.description: Amount of noise added to distorted image challenges.

noiseColor.description: Noise color for distorted image challenges.

custom.description: Custom challenge-response pairs. A custom CAPTCHA requires at least one valid pair; otherwise the module falls back to math.

challenge.description: Plain text displayed with HTML escaping, or a custom challenge key matched by the decoded JSON string parameter of @NEDCAPTCHA-CUSTOM-EMBED.

response.description: Expected text response for this custom challenge. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed; numeric-looking strings are compared literally, with optional case folding controlled by caseInsensitive.

color.description: A color accepted by the module: #rrggbb, rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rrggbbaa, or a comma-separated RGB/RGBA triplet.
